description: The if-so payments where an address is the sender or the recipient, newest first, 20 at a time (the same list as the web dashboard, from the IFSO index of the chain, up to the newest 100). Each item has the id, status, amount, the other side and the expiry. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. For the live chain state of one payment use ifso_get_payment.

address.description: The wallet address to look up (sender or recipient).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous answer: the list continues after that payment.

limit.description: How many payments to return (default and most 20).

name: ifso_list_payments
title: IFSO payments for an address
